self.text: I’m Lucia, a non‑binary design student from Egypt in my early twenties who loves to remix the past by restoring bikes. I get a kick out of turning a rusty frame into a gleaming ride, and I often find myself humming while I sand and polish. When I’m not at my workshop, I’m diving into statistics—an area that lets me see patterns and craft better designs. I enjoy tackling problems by working through them together, sharing the moment of discovery rather than giving or receiving formal tutoring. My sessions are all online, so we can connect from wherever we are, and I’m usually free on Sunday mornings to dive into a new challenge. I’m hopeful to meet someone who’s curious, patient, and ready to explore data or design together, all while sharing the joy of turning something old into something new. I’m excited for the next ride or calculation we’ll solve together.
